events.title: Washington State bans octopus farming (HB 1153)
events.summary: House Bill 1153, sponsored by Rep. Strom Peterson, prohibiting the farming of octopus in Washington State was signed by the governor; the policy takes effect 90 days after signature.
events.source_title: Octopuses in Washington to remain in their little hideaways beneath the waves, safe from farming. – Washington State House Democrats
events.notes: Exact signing day not stated on the source page (post dated 2024-03-13 says the bill 'has been signed'). Described by advocates as the first octopus farming ban.

events.title: California signs OCTO Act banning octopus farming and sale of farmed octopus
events.summary: Governor Gavin Newsom signed the California Oppose Cruelty to Octopuses (OCTO) Act, prohibiting octopus farming and sales of commercially farmed octopus; over 130 Aquatic Animal Alliance members signed a support letter and ALI gave testimony.
events.source_title: The Media Celebrates California's Historic Ban on Octopus Farming — Aquatic Life Institute
events.notes: Bill co-sponsored by Animal Legal Defense Fund and Social Compassion in Legislation (not entities in this dataset). Source is an advocacy organisation's blog.

events.title: Eurogroup/CIWF case study on environmental risks of Nueva Pescanova octopus farm
events.summary: Eurogroup for Animals and Compassion in World Farming published a case study on the proposed Canary Islands octopus farm, noting the Canary Islands Government had rejected Nueva Pescanova's simplified environmental impact assessment and required a fuller one.
events.source_title: Exposing the environmental risks of octopus farming — Eurogroup for Animals
events.notes: Search results reported that Nueva Pescanova later withdrew its octopus farm plans (SeafoodSource), but that article was blocked (HTTP 403) and the withdrawal and its date were not verified.

events.title: ALI releases 3rd Aquaculture Certification Schemes Benchmark
events.summary: Aquatic Life Institute published the third edition of its benchmark of welfare requirements in 8 seafood certification schemes and 1 ratings agency; ASC ranked top (8/10, assessed on its draft farm standard) and RSPCA second.
events.source_title: 2024 Aquaculture Certification Schemes Benchmark: Aquatic Animal Welfare — Aquatic Life Institute
events.notes: ASC score from ALI's 2024-10-10 blog post; RSPCA ranking from ALI feed item titled 'RSPCA Ranks 2nd in 2024 Aquaculture Certification Schemes Benchmark' (2024-10-18).

events.title: First portable in-water shrimp stunner installed in Thailand
events.summary: Thai shrimp farm Sea Farms became the first to install Ace Aquatec's small transportable A-HSU stunning system for crustaceans, through a partnership with Shrimp Welfare Project.
events.source_title: Ace Aquatec and Shrimp Welfare Project launch new portable in-water stunning system

events.title: Scottish Parliament reception on farmed fish welfare
events.summary: The Humane League UK, Animal Equality UK and The Animal Law Foundation held a reception in the Scottish Parliament on farmed fish welfare, calling for legislation requiring pre-slaughter stunning, as recommended by the Animal Welfare Committee in 2023.
events.source_title: Parliamentary reception shines a light on forgotten fishes — The Humane League UK
events.notes: Event date inferred from the article (dated 22 Jan 2025) saying the reception was held 'last night'.

events.title: Co-op (UK) commits to electrical stunning for all farmed prawns by 2027
events.summary: UK retailer Co-op stated that all its fresh and frozen prawns are ablation-free and committed to implementing electrical stunning across its whole prawn supply chain by 2027; the policy was developed with support from Aquatic Life Institute.
events.source_title: Co-op Announces Progressive Prawn Welfare Policy — Aquatic Life Institute
events.notes: Co-op's own announcement was not fetched; quote is reproduced on ALI's blog.

events.title: Animal Ask review of fish farming economics in Europe
events.summary: Animal Ask published a systematic review of the economics of European aquaculture (salmonids, bass and bream, carp), part of a multi-organisation project with Rethink Priorities and Welfare Footprint to guide fish welfare movement strategy.
events.source_title: The economics of fish farming and fish welfare in Europe — Animal Ask
events.notes: Publication date from the Animal Ask RSS feed. A companion post on mapping the European farmed fish supply chain is dated 2025-05-01.

events.title: ASC launches unified Farm Standard with welfare provisions
events.summary: The Aquaculture Stewardship Council launched its unified Farm Standard in May 2025; Aquatic Life Institute described it as making aquatic animal welfare a central pillar after five years of its engagement with the revision.
events.source_title: Behind the Reform: ALI's Role in Shaping the ASC Farm Standard Revision — Aquatic Life Institute
events.notes: Specific welfare clauses of the standard were not reviewed. ASC news (Oct 2026) reports the first salmon producer (Bakkafrost) certified against the new standard.

events.title: Welfare Footprint paper quantifies pain of trout air asphyxia
events.summary: A Scientific Reports paper applying the Welfare Footprint Framework estimated about 10 (1.9-21.7) minutes of moderate to intense pain per rainbow trout killed by air asphyxia and modelled the cost-effectiveness of electrical stunning.
events.source_title: Air asphyxia in rainbow trout slaughter | WFI
events.notes: Scientific Reports 15, 19850 (2025); DOI 10.1038/s41598-025-04272-1. Exact publication date not shown on WFI page.

events.title: Shrimp Welfare Project's 21st stunner MOU (CAMIMEX, Vietnam)
events.summary: Vietnamese producer CAMIMEX joined SWP's Humane Slaughter Initiative, receiving an electrical stunner, with Netherlands-based supplier Seafood Connection committing to prioritise buying stunned shrimps; SWP estimates the programme now reaches about 4 billion shrimps a year.
events.source_title: Major Milestone for Humane Slaughter: Shrimp Welfare Project Expected to Help 4 Billion Shrimps Annually; New MOU with CAMIMEX, Seafood Connection
events.notes: Impact figure is SWP's own estimate.

events.title: Scottish Government commits to official guidance on farmed fish welfare
events.summary: According to The Animal Law Foundation, the Scottish Government committed in September 2025 to introducing official guidance on fish welfare, after the Foundation argued that the industry Code of Good Practice does not explain how to meet legal obligations.
events.source_title: OfFISHial Guidance — Animal Law Foundation
events.notes: Reported by an advocacy organisation; Scottish Government statement not fetched.

events.title: Bill to ban octopus farming introduced in Chile
events.summary: Fundación Veg and Congresswoman Marisela Santibáñez submitted Bill No. 17913-12 to Chile's Congress to ban centres or systems for breeding, reproducing or fattening octopod species nationwide, with technical support from the Aquatic Animal Alliance.
events.source_title: Chile takes a visionary step to protect octopuses and the oceans — Aquatic Animal Alliance
events.notes: Bill introduced only; passage status not checked. Year of 15 Oct inferred from feed date of the post (2025-10-22).

events.title: Shrimp Welfare Project named ACE Recommended Charity for 2025
events.summary: Animal Charity Evaluators named Shrimp Welfare Project one of its 2025 Recommended Charities, the third consecutive year SWP received the recommendation.
events.source_title: Shrimp Welfare Project Named 2025 Recommended Charity by Animal Charity Evaluators

events.title: England's Animal Welfare Strategy says boiling crustaceans alive is not acceptable
events.summary: The UK Government's Animal Welfare Strategy for England stated that boiling crustaceans alive is not acceptable and committed to publishing guidance in 2026 on lawful humane killing methods; Crustacean Compassion and The Animal Law Foundation had campaigned on the issue.
events.source_title: From a boiling alive ban, to a push for full legal protection: 2026 is the year for decapod welfare — Crustacean Compassion
events.notes: Source read via WebFetch (curl hit a bot check). Government strategy document itself not fetched. The Animal Law Foundation (AAA blog, 2026-02-11) describes the government as accepting the practice is illegal under existing law.

events.title: NYC Bar Animal Law Committee endorses federal OCTOPUS Act
events.summary: The New York City Bar Association's Animal Law Committee released a report endorsing the federal OCTOPUS Act of 2025, which would prohibit commercial octopus aquaculture and restrict trade in farmed octopus in the US; the report cites ALI materials.
events.source_title: Legal Voices Back Preventive Approach to Octopus Farming: NYC Bar Association Endorses Federal OCTOPUS Act — Aquatic Life Institute
events.notes: The OCTOPUS Act is a pending federal bill; its legislative status was not checked. NYC Bar report itself not fetched.

events.title: Bill to ban cephalopod farming introduced in Mexico's Senate
events.summary: Senator Maki Esther Ortiz Domínguez introduced a reform of Mexico's General Law of Sustainable Fisheries and Aquaculture to prohibit commercial aquaculture of any cephalopod species, led by Fundación Veg with support from ALI and the Aquatic Animal Alliance.
events.source_title: Four Years of Evidence-Based Advocacy Behind Mexico's Octopus Farming Ban Bill — Aquatic Animal Alliance
events.notes: Bill introduced only. Web search snippets gave 25 Feb 2026 as the introduction date; not confirmed on the fetched page.

events.title: Kenya launches national fish welfare SOP for aquaculture
events.summary: At the 11th Our Ocean Conference in Mombasa, Kenya's government launched the National Manual Standard Operating Procedure for Fish Welfare in Aquaculture (FW-MSOP), described as the first such national framework in Africa; OHDI's AFIWEL programme supported its development.
events.source_title: From Vision to National Policy: Kenya Launches Africa's First National Fish Welfare Manual Standard Operating Procedure (FW-MSOP) — Aquatic Animal Alliance
events.notes: Source is a guest post by OHDI on the AAA blog; Kenyan government documents not fetched.

events.title: Buenos Aires court recognises two goldfish as sentient subjects of rights
events.summary: A Buenos Aires criminal court approved a pretrial probation agreement recognising two goldfish kept in a sushi restaurant tank as sentient beings and subjects of rights rather than property, in a case brought by Jaulas Vacías under Law 14,346.
events.source_title: Sentient: An Argentine Court Recognizes Two Goldfish as Subjects of Rights — Aquatic Animal Alliance
events.notes: Guest post by Animal Interseccional; court documents not fetched. Concerns ornamental (not food) fish.

events.title: Eurogroup white paper: 'Aquatic animal slaughter: time to make the rules'
events.summary: Eurogroup for Animals published a white paper examining slaughter practices in EU aquaculture and wild-capture fisheries and arguing for mandatory EU-level standards, noting over 130 billion aquatic animals are caught by EU fleets each year.

events.notes: Related Eurogroup publications listed on the page: factsheet on RAS and slaughter (2026-06-04) and policy briefing on fish welfare indicators (2026-04-28).

events.summary: Closed: applications for AIM's February 2027 'Transforming factory farming' cohort have closed. The fully funded two-month programme provides a charity idea, co-founder matching, training and seed-funding access.
events.source_title: Start a charity — Ambitious Impact
events.notes: Next listed cohort (August 2027) is health systems/livelihoods, not animals; applications open January 2027. AIM was formerly Charity Entrepreneurship.

events.title: Horizon Europe HORIZON-CL6-2027-02-FARM2FORK-06: small-scale aquatic food production
events.summary: Forthcoming EU call 'Unleashing the potential of sustainable small-scale aquatic food production and recreational fisheries'; planned opening 20 Apr 2027, deadline 23 Sep 2027. Text says aquatic animal welfare should be considered where relevant.
events.source_title: EU Funding & Tenders topic details: HORIZON-CL6-2027-02-FARM2FORK-06
events.notes: Status 'forthcoming' in the EU Funding & Tenders search API. Human-readable page: https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/topic-details/horizon-cl6-2027-02-farm2fork-06 . Welfare is a secondary consideration, not the call's focus. No open EU call with animal welfare as primary topic was found.

events.title: HSUS and HSI rename to Humane World for Animals
events.summary: The Humane Society of the United States and Humane Society International adopted a single new name, Humane World for Animals.
events.source_title: Humane World for Animals - Wikipedia
events.notes: Wikipedia cites a WJLA report dated 2025-02-13; the organisation's homepage confirms the 'formerly HSUS and HSI' wording but no date.

events.title: LSE announces Jeremy Coller Centre for Animal Sentience
events.summary: LSE announced a new research centre on animal sentience, funded by a £4m multi-year commitment from the Jeremy Coller Foundation, to launch in autumn 2025.
events.source_title: LSE centre animal sentience
events.notes: Funder (Jeremy Coller Foundation) is not a map entity.

events.title: Open Philanthropy renamed Coefficient Giving
events.summary: Open Philanthropy, a major funder of farm animal welfare work, changed its name to Coefficient Giving, signalling a move toward multi-donor funds.
events.source_title: One of the world's most influential philanthropies is changing its name. Here's why it matters. (Vox)

events.title: Animal Ask publishes Kenya advocacy prioritisation report
events.summary: Report identifying promising interventions for animal advocacy in Kenya, including legislation on poultry welfare and preventing a shift to caged layer hen systems.
events.source_title: Animal Advocacy in Kenya: Opportunities For Impact

events.title: US DOJ sues to challenge Michigan cage-free egg law
events.summary: The US Department of Justice filed a federal lawsuit in western Michigan challenging the state's cage-free egg law (in effect since 2025) on interstate commerce grounds.
events.source_title: Federal lawsuit challenges Michigan cage-free egg law
events.notes: Reported by Animal Equality (an advocacy party); the lawsuit's outcome was not checked.

events.title: Wild Animal Initiative awards 13 research grants
events.summary: Wild Animal Initiative selected 13 research projects for a total of $727,658 in wild animal welfare science grants, from about 400 expressions of interest.
events.source_title: Wild Animal Initiative awards 13 grants for wild animal welfare research

events.title: UK Supreme Court upholds acquittals of anti-dairy protesters
events.summary: The UK Supreme Court upheld the acquittals of six campaigners charged with public nuisance over 2022 protests at a Müller dairy site; Animal Rising calls it a precedent on protest rights.
events.source_title: Victory for Protest Rights as Supreme Court Rejects Public Nuisance Appeal
events.notes: Source is the campaign group's own press release; framing is theirs.

events.title: AIM opens first animal-only incubation round
events.summary: Ambitious Impact opened its first animal-only round of the Charity Entrepreneurship Incubation Program (Feb–Apr 2027), with a funded exploration phase leading to a seed funding proposal.
events.source_title: Hive Highlights: August 2026
events.notes: Reported via Hive newsletter; AIM's own announcement not fetched.

events.title: EA Animal Welfare Fund seeks large cage-free proposals
events.summary: The EA Animal Welfare Fund invited proposals to scale cage-free transitions for laying hens, especially in Asia, Latin America and Africa; grants of $100,000 to $5M+.
events.source_title: Hive Highlights: August 2026
events.notes: 15 October was a priority deadline. Reported via Hive newsletter; fund's own call page not fetched.

events.title: Animal Ask publishes India prioritisation report
events.summary: Three-part report on strategic priorities for animal advocacy in India, covering the scale of animal use and recommended asks for aquatic and land animals, policy and food systems.
events.source_title: Leverage Points: strategic prioritisation for Animal Advocacy in India

events.title: Singapore approves cultivated duck and cultivated beef
events.summary: The Singapore Food Agency approved cultivated duck (Parima, April 2026) and the first cultivated beef (Aleph Farms, August 2026), described by GFI APAC as world firsts.
events.source_title: Why Singapore's World-First Cultivated Beef and Duck Approvals Matter - GFI APAC

events.title: White paper on ending cages for pigs in the EU
events.summary: The European Institute for Animal Law & Policy published 'Reforming Pig Welfare in the European Union: The Case for a Cage-Free Future', covering law, welfare and economics of banning sow stalls and farrowing crates.
events.source_title: Our new White Paper: "Reforming Pig Welfare in the European Union"

events.title: Italian cage-ban citizens' bill filed with 62,000+ signatures
events.summary: Over 62,000 certified signatures for a popular-initiative bill to ban cages for all farmed species in Italy were filed with the Senate by Essere Animali and allied groups.
events.source_title: Gabbie Vuote: consegnate in Senato oltre 62 mila firme certificate
events.notes: Signature collection closed 14 Sept 2026; the bill's presentation was announced in the Senate session of 22 Sept. Allies also included LAV, ENPA, OIPA and others not on the map.

events.title: ACE awards latest Movement Grants
events.summary: Animal Charity Evaluators awarded $1,054,939 to 21 projects and organisations after assessing 74 full applications in its latest Movement Grants round.
events.source_title: Announcing our latest Movement Grants
events.notes: URL slug identifies this as round 11.

events.title: ACE launches searchable Research Database
events.summary: ACE launched a searchable database of studies and reports relevant to farmed and wild animal advocacy, rebuilt from its Research Library in collaboration with Open Paws.
events.source_title: Introducing the ACE Research Database

events.title: EU backs phase-out of lead gunshot
events.summary: EU decision-makers backed a restriction phasing out the sale and use of lead gunshot, protecting wild birds from lead poisoning; lead bullets were excluded.
events.source_title: Lead gunshot to be phased out across the European Union

events.title: Asia Farm Animal Day 2026 'One Life' campaign
events.summary: Asia for Animals ran Asia Farm Animal Day (4–10 Oct 2026) online, spotlighting less-noticed farmed animals such as rabbits, donkeys, crustaceans, ducks, frogs and civets.
events.source_title: The Lives We Overlook: Looking Back at Asia Farm Animal Day 2026

events.title: WHO regional centre and GFI APAC sign partnership
events.summary: GFI Asia Pacific and WHO's Asia-Pacific Centre for Environment and Health announced a multi-year partnership including a first WHO report on sustainable food systems and alternative proteins in the Western Pacific.
events.source_title: World Health Organization plans landmark report on sustainable food systems

events.title: MFA releases 2nd 'Serving Up Change' foodservice ranking
events.summary: Mercy For Animals published the second edition of its Serving Up Change report, ranking North American foodservice providers on chicken welfare.
events.source_title: The Hidden Truth Behind the Tray: 2nd Edition of Serving Up Change Report

events.title: NYC Council votes to phase out horse-drawn carriages
events.summary: New York City Council passed Romanch's Law (Intro 943), ending new horse-drawn carriage licences and phasing out the industry by 1 June 2028; mayoral signature was pending.
events.source_title: NYC Council Passes Romanch's Law in Historic Vote to End Horse-Drawn Carriages by 2028

events.title: Denmark to end mink farming by August 2027
events.summary: Denmark decided not to seek an exemption from the EU ban on breeding American mink (listed as an invasive species in 2025), so its remaining seven mink farms must close by August 2027.
events.source_title: Major victory: Denmark to end mink farming

events.title: ACE reports $7.3m counterfactual influenced giving
events.summary: ACE's 2025–2026 influenced giving reports estimate $7.3 million in donations to its Recommended Charities that would not otherwise have occurred, within at least $14.7 million influenced in total.
events.source_title: The Second Year in a Row of Record Generosity: Announcing ACE's 2025–2026 Influenced Giving Reports

events.title: Faunalytics study on farmed animal policy and Brazilian voters
events.summary: Faunalytics surveyed nearly 2,000 Brazilians on which farmed animal policies voters reward or punish, to inform efforts to put farmed animals on Brazil's political agenda.
events.source_title: Votos Pelos Animais: How Farmed Animal Policy Wins Votes In Brazil

events.title: Washington, D.C. and Denver voters pass foie gras bans
events.summary: Ballot measures banning force-feeding and sale of foie gras passed with 73% in D.C. and 66.55% in Denver in the 2026 midterms; both take effect 1 July 2027 barring legal challenges.
events.source_title: Denver and D.C. Have Voted to Ban Foie Gras
events.notes: Campaigns led by Pro-Animal Future (not yet a map entity). Sentient Media is the reporting source, not a party.

events.title: EU 2027 Work Programme omits farm animal cage proposals
events.summary: The European Commission's 2027 Work Programme did not mention promised revisions on laying hens, broiler chickens and pigs; a pig cage proposal had been planned for 2027 under the July Livestock Strategy.
events.source_title: The Commission's New Work Programme: Where Are the Animals?
events.notes: Analysis by an advocacy think tank; the Commission's stated December 2026 poultry proposal timeline was not independently checked.
